questions.question: Use find_extremes with top_n equal to 5, mode equal to both and use add_marginal_bars with show_top equal to True, show_right equal to True in order to know What patterns can you observe in student writing scores across different race/ethnicity groups and parental education levels?

answer.value: Several key patterns emerge: 1) Writing scores generally increase with parental education level (master's degree highest at 75.7, high school lowest at 62.4), 2) Race/ethnicity groups show clear differences (group E highest at 71.4, group A lowest at 62.7), 3) The highest performing combination is group E with master's degree (80.5), while group A with some high school performs lowest (58.6), 4) There is a consistent upward trend in scores as parental education level increases across all race groups.

key_insights: Writing scores increase with parental education level
Race/ethnicity groups show clear score differences
Group E with master's degree has highest score (80.5)
Group A with some high school has lowest score (58.6)
Consistent upward trend across all race groups
